feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 July 2026 11:05pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 01 July 2026 at 11:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north of Ireland tracks eastwards, bringing a frontal zone across the area at first.


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 to 7, veering west or northwest soon after midnight. Decreasing mainly 3 or 4 early tomorrow afternoon, but remaining 5 occasionally 6 in the north and far east of the area. Further decreasing 3 or 4 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate occasionally rough at first tonight, falling slight occasionally moderate tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first becoming fair overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or northwest 2 to 4, occasionally 5 in the east, backing south or southwest 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
